data.body: RP-01 exhaustion exception translation approved without refinement. Maintainer response: “yes”. Decision: when retry exhaustion raises Pydantic `UnexpectedModelBehavior`, walk the standard Python cause chain and re-raise only the exact Rebar-owned `StructuredOutputError` object found there; repeated output-size exhaustion therefore retains its `UnretryableOutputError` subtype. Never blanket-map the upstream class, match on message text, or translate an unrelated `UnexpectedModelBehavior`. If a future Pydantic version stops chaining the Rebar object, fail safe by leaving the upstream exception untranslated. One RP-01 decision remains: additive logical candidate-call accounting.
